requested_by: owner: parlay options across MLB, NFL and WNBA
outcome: ZERO PARLAY RECOMMENDATIONS. No qualified leg exists on any of the three boards, and a parlay cannot be better-qualified than its weakest leg.
standing_rule_stated: A parlay inherits the WORST trust status among its legs. It is a multiplicative bet, so it compounds every leg's error rather than diversifying it. This is the opposite of how parlays are usually pitched and it is why an 'edge' grows so fast across legs — the arithmetic magnifies the model's disagreement, not its accuracy.

leg_availability_by_sport.WNBA: 4 legs fully priced from the owner's 00:30Z capture. Best single leg CON +190 at PRICE_SENSITIVE; the other value leg, PHX +310, is COMPRESSION_CONFLICT.
leg_availability_by_sport.MLB: 3 registered forecasts (CIN@AZ, CLE@COL, MIN@SD) but ZERO prices — no MLB board was captured, so no leg can be screened or priced. They also sit at .507-.548 on starter-blind CAP inputs, i.e. near coin flips carrying almost no information. Fair prices if wanted: AZ -121, COL -111, MIN -103.
leg_availability_by_sport.NFL: NO MODEL EXISTS. DAL@ARI is MARKET_BENCHMARK_ONLY with a null benchmark side because no attributable line was acquired. Brier, log loss, edge and EV are null BY RULE. There is nothing to put in a parlay.

no_three_leg_combination_exists: Only 4 priced legs exist and two pairs are mutually exclusive opposites, so no valid 3-leg parlay can be formed from this board at all.

why_the_top_parlay_is_an_illusion.headline: CON +190 + PHX +310 screens +70.7% EV per unit at +1089.
why_the_top_parlay_is_an_illusion.decomposition: Under MARKET probabilities the same parlay is EV -0.0%. The entire apparent edge is the model's disagreement with the market — none of it comes from the price being generous.
why_the_top_parlay_is_an_illusion.concentration: PHX +310 alone carries 88% of the combined single-leg edge, and PHX is precisely the leg the compression gate REJECTS: market_conf .2561 - model_conf .1141 = 14.20pp, and the lifetime record of edges >= 5pp is 0-6.
why_the_top_parlay_is_an_illusion.break_even: The parlay needs 8.41% to break even. The model says 14.36% (1.71x). The market says 8.41% (1.00x). Every unit of that 1.71x is model opinion.
why_the_top_parlay_is_an_illusion.sensitivity: Blending the model toward the market: 100% model +70.7%, 75% +53.1%, 50% +35.4%, 25% +17.7%, 0% -0.0%. It stays nominally positive across the whole blend ONLY because the quoted price carries near-zero overround (+0.41% / +0.58%) — a cross-book best-odds artifact rather than an offer any single book makes. Against a realistic single-book overround the whole range collapses.
why_the_top_parlay_is_an_illusion.conclusion: A parlay that is 88% dependent on a compression-blocked leg is the compression conflict squared, not a hedge against it.

authority: Wager authority NO, execution UNAUTHORIZED, gate 0/100 NO_PROMOTE, ledger $0. QUALIFIED_PAPER_EDGE remains EMPTY BY CONSTRUCTION until an edge class earns forward validation, and no parlay can be the first thing to occupy it.
what_would_change_this: An MLB price board would make three more legs screenable (though still starter-blind). A single-book two-sided quote would make de-vig valid and remove the overround artifact. Neither changes the compression finding on PHX.
